jsspace.configuration.failures.burning_u:
A capsule that comes down through air with no heat shield, or with the wrong one for that air, burns up.
Off, such a capsule cannot begin to come down, and stays where it is.
jsspace.configuration.failures.crash_lan:
A lander with no legs, or with no propellant left to slow down, crashes.
Off, such a lander cannot begin its landing, and stays where it is.
jsspace.configuration.failures.damaged_t:
A damaged oxygen tank used anyway explodes, destroying the rocket and harming what is around it.
Off, a rocket with a damaged tank does not leave the ground.
jsspace.configuration.failures.too_heavy:
A rocket whose thrust is less than its weight lights its engines and stays on the pad, burning its propellant.
Off, its engines do not light, and nothing is spent.
jsspace.configuration.failures.tooltip: What a badly built or badly kept rocket does: always a consequence of a choice, never bad luck.
jsspace.configuration.failures.worn_stag:
Every flight wears the parts of a reused stage: inspected and repaired, it keeps flying; past its limit unrepaired, an engine shuts down or a tank cracks.
Off, reused stages never wear.
jsspace.configuration.launch.launch_dama:
A pad with no flame trench and no deluge is damaged at launch, and so is what stands around it.
Off, the pad takes no harm, whatever it is built with.
jsspace.configuration.launch.no_launch_i:
The launch panel holds the countdown while a thunderstorm is over the pad.
Off, a rocket launches in any weather.
jsspace.configuration.launch.tooltip: What a launch does to its pad, and the weather it waits for.
jsspace.configuration.orbit.debris.toolt:
A destroyed satellite leaves debris in orbit, which strikes what passes through it and multiplies.
Off, a destroyed satellite leaves nothing behind.
jsspace.configuration.orbit.laser_satell:
The Laser Satellite may strike players and what they built.
Off, for a server without PvP, it harms no player and nothing a player built.
jsspace.configuration.orbit.tooltip: What is left in orbit, and what a satellite may strike.
jsspace.configuration.rockets.falling_st:
A stage that falls with no fall zone and no platform to land on leaves a crater where it comes down.
Off, it only lies where it fell, as wreckage.
jsspace.configuration.rockets.tooltip: What a rocket's spent stages do where they fall.
jsspace.configuration.series.industrial_:
Whether, with J's Industrial installed, its chains become the only path for what both mods make.
Off, what J's Space makes it makes its own way too.
jsspace.configuration.series.tooltip: How J's Space shares its work with the other mods of the series.
jsspace.configuration.travel.cruise_even:
Solar storms, micrometeoroids and failures come on the way between worlds.
Off, the cruise is quiet.
jsspace.configuration.travel.fast_travel:
Whether a rocket or a starship skips its cruise and arrives at once.
Off, the cruise is flown, with its time and its events.
jsspace.configuration.travel.landing_nee:
A crew cannot land on a world until its team knows the world's atmosphere, temperature, radiation, gravity and relief.
Off, a crew may land on any world it reaches, known or not.
jsspace.configuration.travel.tooltip: The way between worlds, and what a crew must know before it lands.
jsspace.configuration.worlds.dust_on_mar:
Dust settles on solar panels on Mars, and now and then a dust storm covers the whole planet.
Off, Mars has no dust on its panels and no dust storms.
jsspace.configuration.worlds.naming_hidd:
The first team to find a hidden world names it.
Off, every world keeps its default name.
jsspace.configuration.worlds.tooltip: What the worlds do, and who names the hidden ones.
